name: Prestige Pine Forest
overview: Prestige Pine Forest is a low-density development of just 316 apartments across 4 towers on 8 acres in Whitefield, close to retail zones, malls, IT hubs and educational institutions. The landscape blends with each tower, with large green pockets designed between and around them, offering a range of 3 and 4-bedroom homes plus penthouses.
highlights: Low-density development — only 316 apartments across 4 towers on 8 acres
Located in Whitefield, close to retail zones, malls, IT hubs and educational institutions
Large green pockets designed between and around each tower
Range of 3 and 4-bedroom homes, including penthouses up to 7,011 sq.ft
Dedicated wellness deck, forest trail and reflexology walk
Multipurpose court, tennis court and cricket net practice area
Futsal playcourt and amphitheater within the landscaped grounds
amenities: Clubhouse with lap pool, pool deck & kids pool

locationInfo.summary: Located in Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield — close to retail zones, malls, IT hubs and educational institutions in one of East Bengaluru's most established residential and commercial corridors.
